Also the strong fixed-coprime-factor obstruction from a constant actual 2k-1 window forcing every leaf k-product list to one pair, without cyclic-generator or homomorphism assumptions. Decide EVERY claim in the CANDIDATE files at its exact stated scope with FATAL/MAJOR/MINOR counts; reconstruct every load-bearing step, quantifier, degenerate/boundary case and every caller into cited dependencies. No other source, author contact or old/held body. A favorable verdict is same-harness written support only, not formal/human/configured-family/novelty acceptance or an original-target solution.
